# Buttons

Interactive button components following DGA design guidelines. Includes 6 variants, 3 sizes, multiple states, and modifiers for destructive actions, dark backgrounds, loading indicators, and floating action buttons.

**Stylesheet:** `components/buttons/buttons.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## Props / Configuration

All available CSS classes and HTML attributes for configuring button components.

| Class / Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.btn` | CSS class | Required | Base button class. Must be applied to all buttons. |
| `.btn-primary` | CSS class | — | Primary brand-colored button for main call-to-action. |
| `.btn-neutral` | CSS class | — | Dark/black button for general-purpose actions. |
| `.btn-secondary-solid` | CSS class | — | Gray-filled secondary button for supporting actions. |
| `.btn-secondary-outline` | CSS class | — | Border-only secondary button with transparent background. |
| `.btn-subtle` | CSS class | — | Transparent button that shows fill on hover. |
| `.btn-transparent` | CSS class | — | Text-only button with no background or border. |
| `.btn-large` | CSS class | Default size | Large size (40px height). This is the default when no size class is applied. |
| `.btn-medium` | CSS class | — | Medium size (32px height) for denser layouts. |
| `.btn-small` | CSS class | — | Small size (24px height) for compact or inline usage. |
| `.destructive` | CSS class | — | Modifier for destructive/danger actions. Changes colors to red tones. |
| `.selected` | CSS class | — | Visual selected/pressed state for toggle buttons. |
| `.btn-loading` | CSS class | — | Replaces label with animated spinner. Button becomes non-interactive. |
| `.btn-icon-only` | CSS class | — | Square button containing only an icon (no label text). |
| `.btn-on-color` | CSS class | — | Modifier for dark/colored backgrounds. Adjusts colors for contrast. |
| `.btn-fab` | CSS class | — | Floating action button with pill shape and elevated shadow. |
| `.btn-fab-large` | CSS class | Default FAB | Large FAB size (56px height). |
| `.btn-fab-small` | CSS class | — | Small FAB size (40px height). |
| `disabled` | HTML attr | `false` | Disables the button. Grays out appearance and prevents interaction. |
| `aria-pressed` | HTML attr | — | Set to "true" for toggle buttons in selected state. |

## Button Variants

The six core button styles. Neutral for general actions, Primary for the main call-to-action, Secondary Solid and Outline for supporting actions, Subtle for low-emphasis actions, and Transparent for inline text-level actions.

```html
<button class="btn btn-neutral">Neutral</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary">Primary</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-solid">Secondary Solid</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Secondary Outline</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle">Subtle</button>
<button class="btn btn-transparent">Transparent</button>
```

## Button Sizes

Three size options to fit different contexts. Large (40px) is the default, Medium (32px) for denser layouts, and Small (24px) for compact or inline usage.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-large">Large (40px)</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-medium">Medium (32px)</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-small">Small (24px)</button>
```

## Button States

Interactive states that provide visual feedback during user interaction. Default, Hover, Pressed, Selected, and Disabled states ensure clear communication of button status.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary">Default</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" style="background-color: var(--color-primary-hover);">Hovered</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary pressed">Pressed</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary selected" aria-pressed="true">Selected</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" disabled="">Disabled</button>
```

## Selected State

Toggle-style buttons with a persistent selected appearance using the aria-pressed attribute. Shown across all variants, including destructive selected states.

```html
<button class="btn btn-neutral selected" aria-pressed="true">Neutral</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary selected" aria-pressed="true">Primary</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-solid selected" aria-pressed="true">Secondary Solid</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-outline selected" aria-pressed="true">Secondary Outline</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle selected" aria-pressed="true">Subtle</button>
<button class="btn btn-transparent selected" aria-pressed="true">Transparent</button>



<button class="btn btn-primary destructive selected" aria-pressed="true">Primary</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-solid destructive selected" aria-pressed="true">Sec. Solid</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-outline destructive selected" aria-pressed="true">Sec. Outline</button>
```

## Destructive Variants

Red-tinted variants for actions that delete data or are irreversible. Available across all six button styles to match the surrounding UI context.

```html
<button class="btn btn-neutral destructive">Neutral</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary destructive">Primary</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-solid destructive">Secondary Solid</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-outline destructive">Secondary Outline</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle destructive">Subtle</button>
<button class="btn btn-transparent destructive">Transparent</button>
```

## Buttons with Icon Font

Using the DGA icon font system instead of inline SVGs. Apply the icon font class directly to a span element inside the button. Supports all sizes and icon-only variants.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Add Item
</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-edit-01"></span>
    Edit
</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle">
    Settings
    <span class="icon dga-icon-setting-06"></span>
</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary destructive">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-delete-01"></span>
    Delete
</button>



<button class="btn btn-primary btn-large">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Large
</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-medium">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Medium
</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-small">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Small
</button>



<button class="btn btn-primary btn-icon-only btn-large">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-icon-only btn-medium">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-icon-only btn-small">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-outline btn-icon-only">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-edit-01"></span>
</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle btn-icon-only">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-delete-01"></span>
</button>
```

## On-Color Variants

Buttons designed for use on dark or colored backgrounds. These variants use white and semi-transparent fills to maintain contrast and readability on the primary brand color.

```html
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-neutral">Neutral</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-primary">Primary</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-secondary-solid">Secondary Solid</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-secondary-outline">Secondary Outline</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-subtle">Subtle</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-transparent">Transparent</button>
```

## Destructive On-Color Variants

Destructive action buttons adapted for dark backgrounds. Red tones are adjusted for visibility against the primary brand color.

```html
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-neutral destructive">Neutral</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-primary destructive">Primary</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-secondary-solid destructive">Sec. Solid</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-secondary-outline destructive">Sec. Outline</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-subtle destructive">Subtle</button>
<button class="btn btn-on-color btn-transparent destructive">Transparent</button>
```

## Loading State

An animated spinner replaces the button label to indicate a pending operation. The button becomes non-interactive during loading to prevent duplicate submissions.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-loading">Loading</button>
<button class="btn btn-neutral btn-loading">Loading</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-solid btn-loading">Loading</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-outline btn-loading">Loading</button>
```

## Floating Action Button (FAB)

Elevated, pill-shaped buttons for primary screen-level actions. Available in Large (56px) and Small (40px) sizes, with both labeled and icon-only variants.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-fab">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Create New
</button>
<button class="btn btn-neutral btn-fab">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Create New
</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-solid btn-fab">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Create New
</button>



<button class="btn btn-primary btn-fab btn-fab-large">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Large FAB
</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-fab btn-fab-small">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Small FAB
</button>



<button class="btn btn-primary btn-fab btn-icon-only btn-fab-large">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-fab btn-icon-only btn-fab-small">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
</button>
<button class="btn btn-neutral btn-fab btn-icon-only btn-fab-large">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-edit-01"></span>
</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-solid btn-fab btn-icon-only btn-fab-small">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-arrow-right-01"></span>
</button>



<button class="btn btn-primary btn-fab" disabled="">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    Disabled FAB
</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-fab btn-icon-only" disabled="">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
</button>
```

## Button Group

Adjacent buttons joined into a single visual unit. Border radii are removed on interior edges to create a seamless segmented control appearance.

```html
<div class="btn-group">
    <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Left</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Center</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">Right</button>
</div>
<div class="btn-group">
    <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline btn-icon-only">
        <span class="icon">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="20" height="20">
                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M12.707 5.293a1 1 0 010 1.414L9.414 10l3.293 3.293a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414l-4-4a1 1 0 010-1.414l4-4a1 1 0 011.414 0z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
            </svg>
        </span>
    </button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary-outline btn-icon-only">
        <span class="icon">
            <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="currentColor" width="20" height="20">
                <path fill-rule="evenodd" d="M7.293 14.707a1 1 0 010-1.414L10.586 10 7.293 6.707a1 1 0 011.414-1.414l4 4a1 1 0 010 1.414l-4 4a1 1 0 01-1.414 0z" clip-rule="evenodd"></path>
            </svg>
        </span>
    </button>
</div>
```

## RTL Support

Right-to-left layout support for Arabic and other RTL languages. Icon placement and button group ordering are automatically mirrored.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-add-01"></span>
    زر RTL
</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary-outline">
    <span class="icon dga-icon-edit-01"></span>
    تعديل
</button>
```
